caption:
Venta Borinc etiketindeki öneri: toprak ve/veya yaprak analizi.

Venta Borinc; bor (B) ve çinko (Zn) içeren bir mikro bitki besin maddeleri karışımıdır. Etiketinde de belirtildiği gibi, ürünün toprak ve/veya yaprak analizi yaptırılarak kullanılması tavsiye edilir.

Kullanmadan önce etiketi okuyunuz.

#Venta #MTMAgro #Borinc #BitkiBesleme
rationale: The idea comes from the label's own words: TOPRAK and YAPRAK differ only in their first two letters, so stacked in the wide black italic display caps their PRAK endings line up. The label's 've/veya' becomes the post's only colour accent, a green slash that echoes the slant of the VENTA logotype. The layout copies the pack: a mist 'bag surface' carries the one loud headline, and a green label band with the raised centre tab separates it from a white 'label' area, where the recommendation is set in label typography (green-deep eyebrow, short green rule, graphite text) above the standard sign-off. The copy stays with the label sentence, with no benefits, doses or numbers added. The B/Zn hexagon badges are left out because the topic is analysis, not the elements, and white letters on amber or leaf green would fail the contrast check.
